agent_answer:
Otis’s past pattern at Cherry Springs was one of active, hands-on involvement: he took part in outreach events there (e.g., the 1998 outreach night Bob brought up) and helped with maintenance, such as replacing boards on Bob’s old wooden observation deck with Marcus in 2007. He continued going until around 2008, then stopped; the memory notes he has not been back since 2008, and a later line says it’s good to be there after 17 years.

Marcus’s question shows he already knows that history because he directly references it: “You and I helped him replace boards in 2007,” and he asks Otis about “Bob’s” old deck as if Otis obviously remembers Bob and the work they did together. Marcus also tells Otis to say hello to Bob, adding “those were good years,” again showing he knows Otis’s shared Cherry Springs history.
